slots.title: Homepage hero slide 2 — Peptide Chain
slots.prompt: Extreme macro photograph of a single continuous thread of clear viscous serum lifting from a shallow pool, caught mid-draw so it forms one unbroken strand arcing across the right two thirds of the frame. The strand refracts a thin clinical blue core, colour #014EB1, with a narrow warm copper rim highlight, colour #B87333, along its upper edge. It rests above a seamless graphite surface, colour #1A1A1A, polished to a wet mirror finish that returns one soft reflection directly beneath the strand. Single hard key light raking in from the right at a shallow angle, one dim fill from the left at twenty percent. The left forty percent of the frame is empty graphite falling into near black, completely even, no detail, no shadow crossing into it, no part of the strand entering it. Editorial product photography, shot on a 100mm macro lens at f8, deep clean blacks, high microcontrast, colour graded cool.

slots.title: Homepage hero slide 3 — Skin, Close
slots.prompt: Extreme macro photograph of one passage of real adult human skin across a cheekbone, filling the right two thirds of the frame. Authentic texture, visible pores, fine vellus hair, natural tonal variation, unretouched, matte finish, no cosmetic product on the surface. The frame is cropped tightly so it stops well below the eye and no facial feature is identifiable. Single hard low key light from the right at a very shallow grazing angle so the skin texture reads as relief with real micro shadows, one dim cool fill from the left. Toward the left of the frame the skin falls away into deep graphite shadow, colour #1A1A1A, and the left forty percent is a smooth even near black field with no detail. Editorial beauty macro, 100mm macro lens at f11, natural skin tones, high microcontrast, restrained cool grade.
slots.negative_extra: full face, eyes, eyebrow, lips, nostril, makeup, glitter, shimmer, foundation, plastic skin, beauty retouching

slots.title: Page-break band — The Peptide Standard
slots.target_slot: index — new full-bleed band after trust_option_a
slots.prompt: Studio photograph of a single upright machined cylinder of solid copper standing alone on a seamless graphite ground, colour #1A1A1A. The copper is lightly brushed with fine concentric turning marks, warm and unlacquered, colour #B87333, reading as a precision laboratory reference standard rather than as any consumer object. It stands in the right half of the frame, positioned so its base sits on the lower third line. One hard key light from the upper left throws a long specular stripe down the cylinder and casts one clean hard shadow to the lower right. The left forty five percent of the frame is unbroken graphite falling to near black, completely even, no detail, no shadow entering it. Still life product photography, 85mm lens at f11, deep blacks, metallic specular detail held, cool grade with warm metal.

slots.title: Page-break band — Evidence
slots.target_slot: index — new full-bleed band before reviews
slots.prompt: Documentary photograph of one pair of blue nitrile gloved hands at a laboratory bench, mid task, holding a single precision pipette above a clear microplate. Forearms enter from the left and the frame stops at the elbow, so no person, face or body is visible. The bench is brushed stainless steel, and behind it matte black instrument housings are thrown far out of focus into a soft dark field. Cool practical lighting from above and slightly behind, hard enough to edge light the glove and the pipette barrel. The right forty percent of the frame is the defocused dark background, smooth and even. Honest reportage style, 50mm lens at f2, shallow depth of field, cool neutral grade, no styling, no perfection.
